arithmetic: Exact integer counts and rational rates; finite decimal output is convenience only.
assertionTested: The reader retains matched task clusters and every episode, reconstructs two failure-rate estimands, and calculates the complete empirical paired task bootstrap distribution for these retained counts.
contrast: attack minus benign, recomputed jointly within every paired draw

estimands.episode_weighted_resolved: ratio of summed failure counts to summed failure plus success counts, separately in each arm
estimands.task_weighted_resolved: equal-weight mean of all declared per-task failure proportions, separately in each arm

missingData.emptyArm: retain declared task and return null rate; never substitute zero
missingData.undefinedDraw: retain null statistic; do not discard draw; block affected percentile interval
missingData.unresolved: retain count; exclude only from resolved denominators; also report all-attempt worst-case bounds

nonClaims: No empirical robot or model result.
No new Lab registry record or producer acceptance.
No verified independent operation or custody.
No exact population confidence coverage or causal attack effect.

assumptions: Independent exchangeable task clusters for generalization; both arms and all episodes are retained together.
The declared tasks and episode population match the target estimand and the rubric is appropriate.
A resolved-only rate can be biased by nonrandom unresolved labels.
uncertainty.interpretation: Exact empirical resampling summary. Nominal confidence coverage is not established; four toy tasks do not support an empirical inference.
uncertainty.quantileRule: left inverse empirical CDF, rank max(1, ceil(p * B)), no interpolation
